data.titulo: Kebebertab 7—Kong’eete King’eeti Jesu Agoi Kegerei Paulo eng’ Korgoret
data.contenido:
Ki king’eet Jesu betutab somok kong’eete kingome. Kimong’ji Jesu kasubikyik konyil mut betunoto. Ki testai komong’ji icheget kasarta ne bo betusiek 40. Kiit kasarta ne kitogosta Jesu kwo kipsengwet kogeerei alamalaikyik alage. Kingosiirto betusiek tamanu, korong’ji Kamuktaindet tamirmiriennyi ne tilil alamalaikyik che ki mi Jerusalem.

Ki ye ibata noto, koyai bunikab Jehovah kerat alamalaik che kiyooktoi eng’ korgoret, nga u noto, ko kiityach malaikaiyat. Kilage koik bunikab Jehovah alamalyet ne kiyooktoi ne kiguure Stepano kot kome. Nga u noto, kinetigei agobo ole ki lewendo Jesu agenge eng’ bunichoto koek kiboitiondennyi, noto ko alamalyet ne kiyooktoi ne kiguure Paulo. Kisiirto kenyisiek somogu ak kebeberiat koyookto Kamuktaindet alamalyennyi ne kiyooktoi ne kiguure Petero kwo koamdechi chito ne ki ma ko Yahudiot ne ki kiguure Kornelio ak bikab gonnyi.

Kisiirto kenyisiek 13 konaam Paulo rutoitonnyi ne tai ne bo amdaet. Kiimut Paulo Timoteo eng’ rutoitonnyi ne bo aeng’. Kineetigei agobo kasarwekab boiboiyet che ki nyor Paulo ak bik che kibendoti tugul koyae boisietab Jehovah. Ki eng’ let keger Paulo eng’ korgoret eng’ emetab Rom. Kisiirto kenyisiek aeng’u kitiach, nga u noto keger kogeny ak kebar. KEBEBERITO bo 7 ko ng’alale tuguk che ki yaagis eng’ kasarta ne bo kenyisiek 32.

TOS ingen ile ng’o kwonyi ak bichu aeng’? Kiguure kwonyi Maria Magdalene, inendet ko alamalietab Jesu. Ko murenichu kailaach ngoroik che leelach, ko malaikaisiek. Yu iitei Maria ko ole kiga kinde bortab Jesu kingo kagome. Kiguure kererit. Nito ko kebenet ne kiga kichob si kegonoree chito ne kagome. Nga u noto, ko ma mi borto! Tos kaib ng’o? Ngegeer.

Kingo kagome Jesu kolenji tisiik Pilato: ‘Kingo sobei Jesu ko ki kale king’eeti ye ibata betusiek somogu. Ko u noto, igonu ng’atutiet keriib kererit si ma chor alamalaikyik bortanyi ak kole koging’eet!’ Kolenji Pilato tisiik koyookto ribik koba koriib kererit.

Kingoit betutab somok kong’eete ngome Jesu, konyo malaikaiyatab Jehovah ak komilda koita ne kiga kigereen kererinoto. Ki arogenso ribik ne bo kwong’ut kot ko ma ta komuch koyai kiy. Kingo iit kererit, kogeer kole ma mi borto! Ko ba alage eng’ ribichoto komwachi tisiik. Tos ingen kit ne ki yai tisiichoto yaach? Ki liban ribik komwa lembech ak komwachi kole: ‘Omwa ole kabwa alamalaikyik kemoi kota keruiytosi ak kochor borto.’

Kingo kagoba ribik, kobwa kwonyik che ki alamalaikab Jesu kererit. Ki kwong’io ne tia kingo keer kole ma mi kiy kererit! Ne ma tianit, kogeer malaikaisiek aeng’ che kiga ilaach ngoroik che leelach, koteeb malaikaisiechoto kole: ‘Amu nee si ocheng’e Jesu eng’ yu? Kaging’eet. Ochakten oba omwachi alamalaikyik.’ Ki rwai kwonyichoto ne bo kwong’ut! Kingo ta ko mi oret, konyo chi ne kiitelel. Tos ingen ile ki ng’o chichoto? Ki Jesu. Kolenji Jesu kwonyichoto anyun: ‘Oba omwachi alamalaikyuk.’

Kingo mwachi kwonyichoto alamalaik kole sobei Jesu ago ka kogeer inendet, ko ma iyan. Ki rwai anyun Petero ak Johana agoi kererit kogeerchigei, nga u noto ma nyor kiy eng’ kererit! Kingo ba eng’ yoto Petero ak Johana, kong’et Maria Magdalene. Kasarito ye ki iitei Maria keretit orit ak kogeer malaikaisiek aeng’.

Tos ingen ile kiyaak nee eng’ bortab Jesu? Ki isto Jehovah bortab Jesu anan ki yai kobetito eng’ kererit. Ma ing’eet Kamuktaindet Jesu eng’ borta ne u ne ki tinyei ko tomo kome. Kiigochi Jesu borto ne bo tamirmiriet ne u ne bo malaikaisiek che mi kipsengwet. Nga u noto, ko si koboorchi alamalaikyik kole sobei kogeny, ko ki ilachi Jesu borto ne imuchi kogeer bik, ko u ye ta kinetigei.Matayo 27:62-66; 28:1-15; Luka 24:1-12; Johana 20:1-12. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KINGO kagoba Petero ak Johana eng’ kererit ne kiga kigonoree bortab Jesu, kong’et Maria inegei eng’ yoto. Kiinaam korir ak ko iitei kererit orit ko u ye igeere eng’ pichait ne mi atindiot ne kagosiirto. Ki keer anyun Maria malaikaisiek aeng’. Koteebe malaikaisiechoto kole: ‘Irirjini nee?’

Kowol Maria kole: ‘Kageib bortab kiptaiyandennyu, ago mongen ole kaginde.’ Kingo kuskong’ Maria, kogeer chito ne ki teleli. Koteebe Maria chichoto kole: ‘Icheng’e ng’o?’

Kiibwati Maria kole ki ribindetab mbaret chichoto ago imuchi ko inendet ne kaib bortab Jesu. Ko u noto, kolenji: ‘Ngot ko inye ne keib bortanyi, imwawo ole kende.’ Eng’ iman, ko ki Jesu chichoto. Ki kailaach borto ne ki ma komuchi konyit Maria. Nga u noto, ko kingo kuur chichoto kainetab Maria, konai Maria kole Jesu. Kolabat Maria anyun kwo komwachi alamalaik kole: ‘Kaageer Kiptaiyat!’

Kingo ta kobendi alamalaik kokwet ne kiguure Emau betunoto koskoleny, konyo chi ak kotestai koba tugul. Kiimegei ne bo kwong’ut alamalaik amu kiga kebar Jesu. Nga u noto, kingobendi eng’ oret, komwa chichoto tuguk che chang’ che bunu Bibilia che ki igagai alamalaik. Kingoamisiei tugul, konai alamalaikyik kole ki Jesu noto. Ki ye ibata, kobet anan kobetito Jesu eng’ kwenunywa, kochakta anyun alamalaichoto aeng’u koweektagei Jerusalem komwachi alamalaik che kiyooktoi agobo inendet.

Kingo ta kotesetai tuguchu, komong’ji Jesu kora Petero. Kingo kas alamalaik alage, ko boiboitu ne bo kwong’ut. Ki ba anyun alamalaichugai aeng’u agoi Jerusalem konyor che kiyooktoi. Kingo nyor, komwachi ole kimong’jindo Jesu kora kingobendi eng’ oret. Kingo ta komwau ng’alechuto, ko tos ingen kit ne bo kwong’ut ne ki yaak?

Igeere nee eng’ pichaini? Kanyo Jesu rumit orit agot inganda kerat kurget. Boiboen alamalaik ne bo kwongut, tos ma iman? Tos iit ile kasarwek ata che kogomong’ji Jesu kasubikyik? Tos konyil mut?

Ki ma komi Tomas kingomong’jin Jesu alamalaik. Kolenji alamalaik Tomas: ‘Ka kegeer Kiptaiyat!’ Kole Tomas ma iyani agoi kogeerjigei inegei. Kingobata betusiek sisitu, kotuiyechi alamalaik rumit ne ki kerat ago ki mi Tomas agine. Konyo ruminoto Jesu, kingo keer anyun Tomas, koyan.Johana 20:11-29; Luka 24:13-43. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KINGO tesetai kobendi betusiek, komong’ji Jesu alamalaikyik konyil che chang’. Mi kasarta agenge ne kimong’ji alamalaik che negit 500. Tos ingen ile ki ng’alalji alamalaichoto agobo nee? Ki ng’alalee agobo bounatetab Kamuktaindet. Kiiyok Jehovah Jesu konyo ng’ony si konet bik agobo Bounatet, ago ki testai koyai ko u noto agot kingo kaging’eet eng’ meet.

Tos ta ibwati ile bounatetab Kamuktaindet ko nee? Bounatet ko serkalitab Kamuktaindet ne mi kipsengwet, ago ki lewen Jehovah Jesu koek laitoriat. Ko u ye kiginetgei, ko kiibor Jesu kole ta tun koegu laitoriat ne kararan ne bo kwong’ut kingo bai bik che kiamei rubet, kingosoob che ki miandos ak kong’eet che kigobeg!

Ko u noto, tun ye laitoran Jesu kenyisiek elfut agenge eng’ kipsengwet, ko tun ko u nee ng’ony? Eng’ iman, ko tun koegu ng’ony tugul paradiso. Tun ko ma ko mi boriosiek, yaitiet, mianwogik ak meet. Kingen kele iman nito amu ki kayai Kamuktaindet ng’ony koek paradiso si kobiit koboibochi bik. Noto amu nee si koyai Jehovah mbaretab Eden eng’ tai, ago tun koteleljin Jesu tuguk che machei Kamuktaindet koyai kosulda.

Kiit anyun kasarta ne bo koweektagei Jesu kipsengwet. Ingen alamalaik komie kole sobei Jesu amu kiga koboorjigei icheget eng’ kasartab betusiek 40. Nga u noto, ko kotomo koweektagei, kolenji alamalaikyik: ‘Otebee Jerusalem agoi onyoru tamirmiriet ne tilil.’ Tamirmiriet ne tilil ko kimnatetab Kamuktaindet ne toreti kiboitinikyik koyai magennyin. Kergei kimnatonito ak koristo ne usei. Kolenji anyun Jesu alamalaikyik: ‘Nyolu oamde agobo ane agoi komoswek che loen che bo ng’ony.’

Kingo kagomwa Jesu ko u noto, koyaak kit ne bo kwong’ut. Kiinaam kotogosta kwo barak kipsengwet ko u ye igeere eng’ pichait. Kotuch anyun bolik Jesu, ago ma ta kogeer alamalaikyik kogeny. Kiit anyun Jesu kipsengwet ak konaam kolaitoran kasubikyik che mi ng’ony.1 Korintoek 15:3-8; Ng’ang’utiet 21:3, 4; Boisionik 1:1-11. Teebutik che Kineetengei

BICHU igeere eng’ pichait ko kasubigab Jesu. Kogas it Jesu ak kotebi eng’ Jerusalem. Kingo ta kogenisiei, kobiit sautit ne o eng’ got ago ki u sautinoto cheetab usonet anan koristo ne kim. Kingobata, konaam kotook kit ne u mat eng’ metowekab alamalaik. Tos igeere kioto u mat eng’ metitab alamaliet age tugul eng’ pichait? Ibooru nee nito?

Ki kwong’utiet nito! Kiga koweektagei Jesu kipsengwet ole mi Kwandanyi, ago inendet ne karoong’ji tamirmiriet ne tilil kasubikyik. Tos ingen kit ne ki toret tamirmirionoto alamalaik koyai? Kiinaam kong’alal tugul kutuswek che teerchin.

Kingo kas bik che ki mi Jerusalem sautit ne u cheetab usonet anan koristo ne kim, kobwa kogeer kit ne ki tesetai. Bik alak eng’ chuto ko bikab bororiosiek alak che kabwa igoortab Israelik ne kiguure Pentekost eng’ Jerusalem. Ko kwong’io bichoto ne bo kwong’ut amu kigas kong’alali alamalaik eng’ kutuswekwak agobo tuguk che kororon che ki koyai Kamuktaindet!

Komwa bichoto kole: ‘Bunu bichu tugul Galili, ara imuktoi ano kong’alal kutuswek che teerchin che bo emotinwek che kibunu?’

Ki tonon Petero anyun ak kong’alal eng’ sautit ne o koarorji bichoto agobo ole ki kibarta Jesu ak komwa kole kiing’eet Jehovah inendet. Kotestai Petero kole: ‘Mi Jesu eutab tai ne bo Kamuktaindet eng’ kipsengwet nguno, ago kagoroong’ tamirmiriet ne tilil ne kigamwa kole iyoogu. Noto amu nee si kaogas ak ogeerjigei kwong’utichu.’

Kingomwa Petero ng’alechu, koimgei bik che chang’ agobo tuguk che ki kagiyachi Jesu. Koteeb bichoto kole: ‘Ara magat keyai nee?’ Kolenji Petero: ‘Magat owalage ak kibatisanak.’ Ki kibatisan anyun betunoto bik che negit 3,000 ak koek bichoto kasubikab Jesu.Boisionik 2:1-47. Teebutik che Kineetegei

TOS igeere malaikaiyat eng’ pichait koga koyat kurgetab korgoret? Bichu yatyin kurget, ko alamalaikab Jesu che kiyooktoi. Ngegeer amu nee si keger alamalaichuto eng’ korgoret.

Kogosiirto kasarta kitigin kityo kong’eete keroong’ji alamalaikab Jesu tamirmiriet ne tilil. Keer anyun kit ne yaaksei: Mi Petero ak Johana kobendi hekalut ne mi Jerusalem bet. Eng’ ole negite kurget, ko mi chi ne solomwet. Cham komutu bik chichito kila betut konyo yuto si kosom robisiek bik che bendi hekalut. Kingo keer chichi Petero ak Johana, kosom kiy kitigin. Ara si koyai nee anyun Petero ak Johana?

Ki tononso ak kogeer chichi nyalili. Kolenji anyun Petero chichoto: ‘Ma tinye robisiek, nga u noto, agonin kit ne atinye. Eng’ kainetab Jesu, ng’eet ak iwe!’ Konam anyun Petero eutab tai ne bo chichoto. Kingonam, kotoromben chichoto ak konaam kowendot. Kingo keer bik kokwong’io ak koboiboitu mising’ eng’ kwong’utionioto.

Kole Petero: ‘Kagiyai kwong’utioni eng’ kimnatetab Kamuktaindet ne kiing’eet Jesu eng’ meet.’ Kingo ta konetisiei Petero ak Johana, kobwa kandoikab dini. Ki nerekyotin kandoichuto amu kiineti bik Petero ak Johana agobo ng’eetyetab Jesu. Konam anyun kandoichoto Petero ak Johana ak konde korgoret.

Ki betut ne rubei, koyai tuiyet ne o kandoikab dini. Ki kimut Petero ak Johana koboto chichi kigisoobi kobwa ole ki mi tuiyet. Koteebe kandoikab dini kole: ‘Ko oyai kwong’utioni eng’ kimnatetab ng’o?’

Kowolji Petero kolenji ki yai kwong’otionoto eng’ kimnatetab Kamuktaindet ne kiing’eeti Jesu eng’ meet. Ki betyi tisiichoto kit ne yae amu, ki ma komuchi koeesio kole ki yaak eng’ iman kwong’utionoto. Ko u noto, kolenji alamalaik che kiyooktoi mat ko ta kong’alalee Jesu kogeny ak kotyach koba.

Kingo tesetai kobendi betusiek, kotesetai agichek alamalaik che kiyooktoi koamdoi logoiywek agobo Jesu ak kosoobi che miandos. Kigasak kwong’utichoto. Kobwa anyun bik che chang’ che ki bunu nganasok che ki negite Jerusalem komutu bik che miandos si kobiit kosoob alamalaik. Amu noto koam ng’etkong’ kandoikab dini ago ki nam alamalaik ak konde korgoret. Nga u noto, ko ma tebi eng’ korgoret koek keny.

Kingoit kemoi, koyat malaikaiyatab Kamuktaindet kurgetab korgoret ko u ye igeere eng’ pichait ak kolenji alamalaik: ‘Oba agoi hekalut, ak otestai oamdochi bik.’ Ki betut ne rubei, koyookto kandoikab dini bik koba komutyi alamalaik eng’ korgoret, nga u noto ko ki ma komi. Ki nyor bichoto ko mi alamalaik hekalut konetisiei ak komut koba Sanhedrin. Sanhedrin ko ki kapkiruok ne bo barak ne bo Yahudik.

Komwa kandoikab dini kole: ‘Ki kigonok ng’atutiet kele mata taonetisie agobo Jesu kogeny. Nga u noto, ko kionyiit Jerusalem kanetutikwok.’ Kowol alamalaik che kiyooktoi kole: ‘Magat kegas it Jehovah kosiir bik.’ Ki testai anyun alamalaik konet bik “logoiywek che miach.” Tos ma kaborunet ne kararan noto ne nyolu kisub?Boisionik kurgetab 3 agoi 5. Teebutik che Kineetegei

CHICHI igeere eng’ pichait kogutunyi ko Stepano ago inendet ko alamalyetab Jesu. Tos igeere kit ne itoi bichu Stepano? Lachee koik. Amu nee si ko sas Stepano ne tee ni kot koyachi kit ne ya ne u ni? Ngegeer.

Cham kotoreti Kamuktaindet Stepano koyai kwong’utik. Ma boibochi bichu noto, ko u noto kotiiyo anan kong’ichgei agobo konetisietab Stepano ne kiineti bik imanda. Nga u noto, ko kiigochi Kamuktaindet Stepano ng’omnatet ne o, ago kiiboor Stepano kole cham koneti bichu bik lembech. Koyai nito konerekyo bichu mising’. Ko u noto, konam bichuto Stepano ak koguur bik si komwaitae lembeita.

Koteebe tisiindet ne o Stepano kole: ‘Tos mwae bichu iman?’ Kowol Stepano eng’ amdaet ne kararan ne bunu Bibilia. Kingotaroti amdaennyi komwa agobo bik che yaach che ki sasei maotikab Jehovah keny ak kole: ‘Okergei ak bichoto. Ki obar Jesu kiboitiotab Jehovah ago ma ogas it ng’atutikab Kamuktaindet.’

Ki yai nito konerekyo ne bo kwong’ut kandoichoto ak konyei kelekwak eng’ nereknatet ne o! Konyal barak Stepano ak kole: ‘Ogeero! Ageere Jesu koteleli eng’ eutab tai ne bo Kamuktaindet eng’ kipsengwet.’ Ki keree bichoto eunekwak itik ak konam Stepano ak kochuut komanda eng’ nganaset.

Kingomi yoto anyun, koreek anan konemu bichuto kotisiekwak ak kogochi neranet agenge ne kiguure Saul. Tos igeere Saul eng’ pichait? Kiinaam anyun alak eng’ bichuto kolach Stepano. Kogutuny Stepano ko u ye igeere eng’ pichait ak kosa Kamuktaindet kole: ‘Jehovah, mat iger kong’ bichu amu kayai kiito ya.’ Kiingen Stepano kole alak eng’ bichuto ko kiiberber kandoikab dini. Kingobata nito anyun, kome Stepano.

Ngot ko yaun chi kiy ne ya, ko tos iyachi ak inye ko u ye ka yaun anan agot isom Kamuktaindet konyalil chichoto? Ma yai Stepano ak Jesu ko u noto. Ki yachi bik tugul che miach agot bik che ki ma yachi icheget eng’ mieindo. Nyolu keegu anyun bik che u Stepano ak Jesu.Boisionik 6:8-15; 7:1-60. Teebutik che Kineetegei

TOS ingen ile ng’o chichi ruei eng’ ng’ony? Kiguure Saul. Tos ta ibwati ile inendet ne ki ribchin kotisiek bichu ki lachei Stepano? Keer lapkeiyet eng’ pichait! Nee ne yaaksei?

Kingo kagebar Stepano, kondochi Saul bik kocheng’ ak kobar kasubikab Jesu. Ki wendi got eng’ got konamei kasubikab Jesu ak kowirji korgoret. Ki yai nito komwechi kasubikab Jesu nganasok alak ak konaam koamda “logoiywek che miach” eng’ oloto. Nga u noto, ko ki wo Saul nganasok alak kocheng’ kasubikab Jesu. Mi oret nguni kowendi Damasko. Kingo ta kowendi, koyaak kit ne bo kwong’ut:

Ki iluchi anan ki ikweny Saul lapkeiyet ne ki bunu kipsengwet, kobut ko u ye kigeere eng’ pichait. Kogas anyun sautit ne kile: ‘Saul, Saul! Amu nee si inyalilon?’ Kigeer lapkeiyet bik che ki mi ak Saul ak ko kas sautit, nga u noto ko ma iguiyo kit ne ki kimwae.

Koteeb Saul kole: ‘Kiptaiyat, i ng’o?’

Kogas sautit ne ki wol kole: ‘A Jesu ne inyalili.’ Ki mwa Jesu ko u noto amu kingonyalil Saul kasubikyik ko ki kas ko u yo kiginyalil inendet.

Koteeb anyun Saul kole: ‘Kiptaiyat, ara ayai nee?’

Kole Jesu: ‘Ng’eet ak iwe Damasko. Ye iit kemwaun kit ne magat iyai.’ Kingo telel Saul ko ki ma ta kogeertoi, kiga kogor! Ki nam anyun eut bik che ki bendi tugul ak komut agoi Damasko.

Kong’alalji anyun Jesu agenge eng’ alamalaikyik che ki mi Damasko kolenji: ‘Anania, ng’eet ak iwe oret ne kiguure Ne Litit. Ye iit gotab Juda, iteeb chito ne kiguure Saul. Kaalewen inendet ak atabaan koek kiboitiondennyu.’

Ki gas it anyun Anania Jesu ak kwo. Kingo tuiyo ak Saul, kogonor Anania eunekyik ak kolenji: ‘Kaiyokwo Kiptaiyat si kobiit igeerte kogeny ak kinyiitin tamirmiriet ne tilil.’ Sainoto, komong’unee konyekab Saul tugun che u berik ak konaam kosoita anan kogeerto kogeny.

Ki kiboisie Saul eng’ oret ne o keamdechi bikab bororiosiek che chang’. Kinyo keguuree Paul ne kiyooktoi, ta kinetigei che chang’ agobo inendet. Ngegeer korok kit ne iyooktoi Kamuktaindet Petero kwo koyai.Boisionik 8:1-4; 9:1-20; 22:6-16; 26:8-20. Teebutik che Kineetengei

CHICHI igeere ko teleli eng’ tai ko Petero, ko bichu mi batennyi ko choronokyik. Ara anyun amu nee si ko kogutug’ji chichi Petero? Tos nyolu koyai ko u noto, ago ingen ile ng’o chichito?

Kiguure chichito Kornelio ago inendet ko askarindetab Rom. Ma ingen Kornelio Petero, nga u noto ko kigilenji kotaach Petero konyo gonnyin. Ngegeer amu nee si koyaak ko u noto.

Kasubikab Jesu che tai ko ki Yahudik, nga u noto ko ma Yahudiot Kornelio. Agot inganda ma Yahudiot inendet, ko chamei ak kosae Jehovah. Yachin bik kora tuguk che kororon. Ki nyonji malaikaiyat betut agenge ak kolenji: ‘Baibai Jehovah agobo inye, ago wolun sautiguk. Iyookte biguk koba koguur chito ne kigureen Petero. Mi gotab Simon ne menyei ole negite nyanjet eng’ Jopa.’

Kiiyookto anyun sainoto Kornelio bik ko ba kocheng’ Petero. Kingo negit koit Jopa bichoto, ko ki mi Petero got barak eng’ gotab Simon. Betusiechoto, ko ki cham keteechei gorik barak eng’ oret ne imuchi kotebee bik. Kingo mi yoto Petero koboorji Kamuktaindet ngoriet ne ki chorugei eng’ kipsengwet. Ki mi tiong’ik che teerteer ngorionoto. Ki ma kotililen tiong’ichuto kosubgei ak ng’atutikab Kamuktaindet, nga u noto ko kigas Petero sautit ne kilenji: ‘Petero, ng’eet bar ak iam.’

Kowol Petero kole: ‘Achicha! Tomo aame kiy ne ma tilil.’ Nga u noto kolenji sautinoto: ‘Mat ile ma tililen tuguk che kagomwa Kamuktaindet kole tililen.’ Ki yaak ko u nito konyil somok. Kingo ta koteebengei Petero kit ne ibooru tuguchoto, koit bik che kiga iyook Kornelio ak koteeb Petero.

Koreg Petero eng’ koroba ak kole: ‘Ane chito ne ocheng’e, omwa!’ Kingoaror anyun bichoto kole kigalenji malaikaiyat Kornelio kotaach Petero kwo gonnyi, koyan anyun Petero ak choronokyik ko ba Kaisaria betut ne rubei korutechi Kornelio.

Kingo itei Petero gotab Kornelio, ko kiga iyum Kornelio tilyanutik ak choronokyik eng’ gonnyi. Kingo tuiyo Kornelio ak Petero, kobutyi Kornelio kelyekab Petero ko u ye igeere eng’ pichait. Kole Petero: ‘Tonon; anendet ko a chito ak ane.’ Eng’ iman kobooru Bibilia kole ma nyolu kegutung’ji chito. Magat keoot Jehovah inegei.

Kiinaam anyun Petero koamdochi bik che ki mi yoto. Kole Petero: ‘Ageere ale iyani Kamuktaindet bik tugul che machei koboisiechi.’ Ago kingo ta kong’alali Petero, koyook Kamuktaindet tamirmiriennyin ne tilil, ago kiinaam kong’alal bik che ki mi yoto kutuswek che teerchin. Ki yai nito ko kwong’io alamalaik che ki Yahudik che kigabwa ak Petero amu kiibwati kole chamei Kamuktaindet Yahudik ichegei. Kiinetgei anyun alamalaichoto kole kaga ma keerei Kamuktaindet ko bo kamanut bikab bororiet age kosiir che bo bororiet age. Tos ma kit ne kararan nito ne nyolu kibwat tugul?Boisionik 10:1-48; 11:1-18; Ng’ang’utiet 19:10. Teebutik che Kineetengei

NERANANI igeere eng’ pichait komi ak Paulo keguure Timoteo, ago menyei ak familia nenywa Lustra. Kiguure kamennyi Eunike, ko gogo anan batieminyin keguuree Lois.

Ne bo somok ni konyonei Paulo Lustra. Kenyit agenge ne kogosiirto ko ki kabwa Paulo ak Barnaba nganasanito, ago ki bwanei boisietab amdaet. Nguni ko kagoweek Paulo Lustra komi ak choruennyi ne kiguure Sila.

Tos ingen kit ne mwachin Paulo Timoteo? Katebee kole: ‘Tos icham inyo kebe tugul? Kimuchi keboisienen iamdochi bik che mi komoswek che looen.’

Kowol Timoteo kole: ‘Ee, ayani kebe tugul.’ Ma tianit kobagach Timoteo bikyik ak koba ak Paulo ak Sila. Ko tomo kinetgei agobo bandanywa, ko ngegeer korok kit ne ki koyaak eng’ sobetab Paulo. Ki kobata kenyisiek 17 kong’eete ngomong’ji Jesu Paulo eng’ oret kowendi Damasko.

Ibwat ile ki nyonei Paulo Damasko konyalili alamalaikab Jesu, nga u noto ko koek alamaliet agine! Kingobata betusiek, kopangan bunik kobar Paulo amu ki ma ko chamei kanetutik che kiineti Paulo agobo Jesu. Nga u noto, ko ki toret alamalaik Paulo komwei. Kiinde kitonget anan mesendet ak kochoorta kobun inatutab nganaset.

Ki wo anyun Paulo koamda eng’ Antiokia. Ki Antiokia ole kiginaamee keguuree kasubikab Jesu Kristianik. Kingo mi yuto Paulo ak Barnaba, kiyookto koba koamda eng’ emotinwek che looen. Agenge eng’ nganasok che ki rutochi ko Lustra, ole ki menyei Timoteo.

Nguno ko negit kogosiirto kenyit agenge, ago konyo Paulo Lustra rutoito ne bo aeng’. Tos ingen ile kingoba Timoteo koboto Paulo ak Sila, ko ki ba ano? Kaigai keer mapit si kobiit kinetgei agobo komoswek che ki ba. Ne tai, ko ki ba Ikonio, kingomanda eng’ Ikonio koba nganaset ne kiguuree Antiokia. Ne rubei koba agoi Troa, kingomanda eng’ yoto koba Pilipi, Tesalonike, ak Berea. Tos igeere Atene eng’ mapit? Ki amda Paulo eng’ yoto kora. Kingobata kwo Korinto ago ki tar kenyit agenge ak nusu eng’ yoto. Ki ba Epeso ak komuuny kitigin eng’ yoto. Koboisiee anyun melit koweektagei Kaisaria, ak kotogosta koba Antiokia ole ki tebee Paulo.

Ko u noto, ko ki wo Timoteo mailisiek bogolusiek kotoreti Paulo koamdaat “logoiywek che miach” ak kotoi tuiyosiekab Kristianik. Ara anyun tun ye ieetu, ko tos iegu kiboitiot ne iyanat ne bo Kamuktaindet ko u Timoteo?Boisionik 9:19-30; 11:19-26; kurgetab 13 agoi 17; 18:1-22. Teebutik che Kineetengei

BWO! Bwo! Nee ne yaaksei eng’ yu? Tos kaumian mising’ lakwani mi ng’ony eng’ pichaini? Agenge eng’ bichu igeere komong’u eng’ go, ko Paulo! Tos igeere Timoteo agine komi yuto? Kalya lakwani, tos kaibut eng’ tirisia?

Ee, noto kit ne kayaak. Ki mi Paulo Troa kong’alaljin alamalaik. Kiingen Paulo kole siirtoi kasarta ne goi si kotuiyo ak alamalaik kogeny amu ki nyolu kwo betut ne rubei. Ko u noto, ko ki ng’alalji alamalaik agoi kemoi kwen.

Kingo ng’alali Paulo, ko kigatebee lakwani tirisiet eng’ koroba ne bo somok, kiguure lakwanito Eutuko. Ki birto met anyun lakwani ak kotururtogei kobun tirisia kong’eete koroba barak! Noto amu nee si igeere koarogendos bichu. Kiarogenso bik che kiganabu amu kiga kome!

Kingo keer Paulo kole kagome, koruee lakwanato ak konam eunikyik ak kole: ‘Moimgei. Mi komie lakwet!’ Ago eng’ iman ko ki mi komie lakwanato amu ki ing’eet Paulo, ki kwong’utiet nito! Ki boiboitu bik ne tia!

Ki togosta anyun tugul koroba barak kogeny koba koamis. Ki testai kong’alal Paulo agoi betut ne rubei bet kwen. Ma ta koru kogeny Eutuko. Kingobata, kolany Paulo melit, Timoteo ak bik che ki bendoti tugul ak koba. Tos ingen ile bendi ano nguno? Mi Paulo kotoroti rutuitonyi ne bo somok ago weektogei gaa. Kasarito, ko ki katebi Paulo eng’ nganasetab Epeso inegei kenyisiek somok. Ko u noto, ko koi rutuitonyi ne bo nguno kosiir ne bo aeng’.

Kingo manda melit eng’ Troa, kotelel kitigin eng’ Mileto. Amu ki ma ko loo Epeso eng’ yoto, koyookto Paulo kobwa boisiekab tuiyet Mileto si kobiit kong’alaji ne bo let. Kingoit kasarta ne inaami banda melit, koimgei ne bo kwong’ut boisiechoto kingo keer kowendi Paulo!

Kiit melit anyun Kaisaria, ago ki meny Paulo gotab alamaliet ne kiguure Pilipu. Kingo mi yuto koteechi maotiot ne keguure Agabo. Kilenji Agabo Paulo yeit Jerusalem, keratei. Ago eng’ iman ko noto kit ne kiyaak. Kingo kagotar kenyisiek aeng’ Paulo eng’ korgoret komi Kaisaria, kiyookto kwo kiruokyi eng’ taitab laitoriatab Rom Kaisari. Ngegeer anyun kit ne ki yaak eng’ oret kobendi Rom.Boisionik kurgetab 19 agoi 26. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KEER o! Kagobutok melit! Tos igeere bik che kagotwalji bek orit? Kagogiilgei alage kobir bek kot komanda eng’ nyanjet. Tos boto Paulo che kagomanda? Ngegeer kit ne kigoyaak.

Ibwat ile kiga kirat Paulo eng’ Kaisaria. Kingosiirto kenyisiek aeng’u, kinde melit ak kimut koba Rom koboto bik che ki kagirat tugul. Kingosiir kwenbeiyotab Krete, konyo koristo ne o ne bo kwong’ut, ki o korisoto kot ko ma ta komuch koget anan kokweri melit ndereba. Ki ma ko toogu agot asista bet agot kecheik anan kogeelik kemoi. Kingosiirto betusiek che chang’ ko ta ko mi bichuto nyanjet, komeiyo mugulelwekwak amu kigeere kole ma mi kamang’unet kesor.

Kotonon anyun Paulo ak kole: ‘Ma meei chi eng’ okwek, butoksei melit inegei kityo. Amu konyo amut kemboi malaikaiyatab Jehovah ak kolenjon, “Meiywei Paulo! Ne matiny itononi eng’ taitab laitoriatab Rom, Kaisari. Ago soru Kamuktaindet bik che omi tugul.”’

Kingoit saisiekab kemboi kwen betutab 14 kong’eete ngonaam koristo anan usonet, konai bik che ki mi melit kole ma ko looen beek! Amu kiiywei kole ki tos rieb koik, kowirta nangainik si kobiit kotelel melit. Kingoeech subui, kogeer ko kagonegitit tabandab nyanjet, koget anan kokweri melit kotokyigei yoto.

Kingoriikta, korieb melit ng’aniek che ki chang’ ak kokwaman. Konaam anyun kokwerakwer beek che mildoigei melit kot kong’asur. Kole askarindet ne ki teleljin: ‘Okwek tugul che omuchi obir beek, otwolji beek ak obe. Ko okwek che mongen obir beek, oboisiee bagoinikab melit ak osub.’ Ki yai ko u noto, komanda anyun bik 276 tugul che ki mi melit eng’ nyanjet kochomegei ko u ye ki kamwa malaikaiyat.

Kiguure yuto Malta. Miach bikab yuto, amu ki toret bik tugul che ki mi melit. Kingo sis usonet, kinde Paulo melit age ak kimut kwo Rom.Boisionik 27:1-44; 28:1-14. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS igeere Paulo eng’ pichait koratat ak komi ak askarindetab Rom ne ribei? Mabusiot Paulo eng’ Rom. Ta kogeni konai kit ne mwaei Kaisari agobo inendet. Kingoratat, ko ki kiyanjin bik korutechi Paulo.

Kingobata betusiek somogu kong’eete kogait Paulo Rom, koyookto keguur kandoikab Yahudik kobwa kotuiyo. Ko u noto, kobwa Yahudik che chang’. Ki amdechi anyun Paulo bichoto agobo Jesu ak bounatetab Kamuktaindet. Kiiyan alage ak koek Kristianik, nga u noto, ko ma iyan alage.

Kiamdochi kora Paulo askarik che teer teer che ki ribei inendet. Eng’ kenyisiek aeng’ che ki tebi Paulo ko ratat eng’ yuto, ko kiamdechi chi age tugul kingomugak. Ki amdechi agot bik che ki mi gotab Kaisari logoiywek che miach che bo Bounatet, ago kiek alage eng’ ichek Kristianik. Ara tos inai ile ng’o chichi sirisiei eng’ meset? Chichito ko Timoteo. Kiga keratei Timoteo agine amu kiamda agobo Bounatet, nga u noto ko kigitiach ago konyo anyun yuto si kotoret Paulo. Tos inai ile sirei nee Timoteo? Ngegeer.

Tos ta ibwati nganasokab Pilipi ak Epeso che kiga king’alalee eng’ atindiotab 110? Ki toret Paulo kinaam tuiyosiekab Kristianik eng’ nganasochoto. Kingomi Paulo korgoret ko ki sirjin baronok Kristianichoto. Kiguure baronochoto eng’ Bibilia Epesoek ak Pilipik. Mwachin nguno Paulo Timotheo kit ne magat kosirji Kristianichoto mi Pilipi.

Ki yachi Pilipik Paulo ne mie amu ki iyookyi konunotiot kingomi korgoret ago nguno komwachin Paulo kongoi agobo noto. Ki Epaprodito ne kiibu konunotiondonoto, ago kingoit ko mian ne ki ta me. Nguno ko kogomieit ago chobot koweektagei gaa, inendet ne titoi baruet ne kasirei Paulo ak Timoteo kwo Pilipi.

Kingomi Paulo korgoret, ko ki sir baronok alak aeng’ kora che mi Bibilia. Agenge ko ki sirji Kristianik che bo nganasetab Kolosai. Tos ingen ile kiguure nee baruanoto? Kiguure Kolosaik. Age, ko ki sirji choruennyin ne kiguure Pilemon ne ki menyei Kolosai. Baruanoto ko king’alaleen kiboitiotab Pilemon ne kiguure Onesimo.

Ki mween Onesimo Pilemon ak konyo Rom. Ki nai eng’ yuto Onesimo kole mi Paulo korgoret ago kiwo korutochi. Kiamdochi anyun Paulo Onesimo ago eng’ let koek Onesimo Kristianindet. Ki yai nito koimgei Onesimo amu kimwei. Tos ingen kit ne ki sir Paulo eng’ baruet ne ki sirji Pilemon?

Kilenji Paulo Pilemon konyochi kaat Onesimo. Kisir kole: ‘Ayogu Onesimo koweek ole imi. Nguno ko ma ko kiboitiondeng’ung’ kityo. Inendet ko tupcheng’ung’ kora ne mie ne Kristianindet.’ Kingoweektogei Onesimo Kolosai, ko ki ibei baronochuto aeng’, ne bo Kolosaik ak ne bo Pilemon. Ibwat boiboiyet ne kinyor Pilemon kingo nai kole ko koek Kristianindet Onesimo!

Kingo sirjin Paulo Pilipik ak Pilemon ko ki tinyei logoiywek che miach che kimwachin. Kilenji Paulo Pilipik: ‘Ayookwok Timoteo ago anyone ak ane ko negit.’ Kosirji Pilemon kolenji: ‘Chobwo ole nyo atebee.’

Kingitiach Paulo, korutochi tupchosiekyik che Kristianik eng’ komoswek che chang’. Nga u noto, ko ki nyo keger Paulo kogeny eng’ Rom ago ki nai kole ki barei kasarata. Ko u noto, kosirji Timoteo kolenji kochook konyo ole ki mi. Ki sir kole: ‘Ki aegu ne iyanat eng’ Kamuktaindet, ago angen ale konon Kamuktaindet melekto.’ Kingobata kenyisiek tutigin kong’eete ngebar Paulo, keng’em Jerusalem, ago ki Romanik che ki ng’emei.

Chang’ tuguk che mi Bibilia. Ki sir Johana bukuisiek che bo let eng’ Bibilia eng’ toretetab Jehovah Kamuktaindet koboto bukuitab Ng’ang’utiet. Ng’alalee bukuinito bo Ng’ang’utiet betusiek che bwanei. Nginetgei anyun agobo tuguk che tun yaaksei eng’ betusiek che bwanei.Boisionik 28:16-31; Pilipik 1:13; 2:19-30; 4:18-23; Hebranik 13:23; Pilemon 1-25; Kolosaik 4:7-9; 2 Timoteo 4:7-9.
